stem: In the prevaccine era, rotavirus was described as the most common cause of which pediatric syndrome?

options.label: A
options.text: Only cervical cancer driven by high-risk HPV 16/18
options.misconception: HPV. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: B
options.text: Only flaccid paralysis caused by wild poliovirus strains
options.misconception: Polio. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: C
options.text: Severe gastroenteritis among infants and young children
options.misconception: None — this option matches the cited source passage.
options.explanation: CDC: most common cause of severe gastroenteritis in infants/children.

options.label: D
options.text: Only whooping-cough catarrhal colds in early pertussis
options.misconception: Pertussis. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: E
options.text: Only meningitis percentages attributed to invasive Hib
options.misconception: Hib. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.
